project.name: tingting
project.description: TingTing — a Vietnamese trucking logistics platform structured as a pnpm monorepo: an Express 5 + TypeScript backend, a React 19 + Vite frontend styled with Tailwind CSS, and a shared package, with Drizzle ORM, JWT+Casbin RBAC, and Docker-based deployment.

nodes.name: backfill-faq-embeddings.ts
nodes.summary: One-off backfill script that embeds FAQ entries with NULL embedding vectors via OpenRouter text-embedding-3-small (1536 dims) and writes them with raw SQL; idempotent and re-runnable after new FAQ rows are added.
nodes.languageNotes: Drizzle cannot express pgvector writes, so vectors are written through raw db.execute SQL literals.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Verifies database reachability, selects FAQ entries whose embedding is NULL, batches question-plus-variants text through the embedding API, and writes each vector via raw SQL UPDATE.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Initializes the singleton postgres.js client and the Drizzle ORM instance bound to the full schema; exported as `db`, this is the database entry point for the entire backend.

nodes.name: master-data-name.ts
nodes.summary: Provides the operationalName SQL helper that prefers a master-data row's configured short name while falling back to the full legal name, keeping operational labels safe for rolling deployments and legacy writers.

nodes.name: operationalName
nodes.summary: SQL expression coalescing a trimmed short name to the full legal column for operational label queries.

nodes.name: migrate-trailers.ts
nodes.summary: One-off data migration extracting trailer plates from the trucks table into the dedicated trailers table, linking trucks via current_trailer_id and backfilling trips.trailer_id, all inside a single idempotent transaction.

nodes.name: migrateTrailers
nodes.summary: Runs the idempotent trailer extraction in one transaction: skips when trailers exist, dedupes truck trailer plates into trailers, then backfills truck and trip foreign keys via set-based SQL.

nodes.name: errors.ts
nodes.summary: Defines ApiError, the canonical HTTP error class carrying statusCode and optional details; all services and routes throw it instead of ad-hoc error-object patterns.

nodes.name: ApiError
nodes.summary: Canonical API error class extended by every backend service; the global error handler translates its statusCode and details into HTTP responses.

nodes.name: reset-seed.ts
nodes.summary: Development reset utility that clears core business tables in foreign-key-safe order (users included) and then dynamically imports the modular seed to rebuild a fresh demo database.

nodes.name: resetAndSeed
nodes.summary: Deletes trip, ledger, expense, pricing, fleet, customer, and user tables in dependency order, then dynamically imports seed.js to reseed.

nodes.name: seed-dashboard.ts
nodes.summary: Standalone dashboard seeder that populates config, reference data, multi-month synthetic trips, receivables ledger entries, and expenses so dashboard KPIs, charts, and attention-panel alerts render meaningful data; idempotent via ON CONFLICT and existence guards.

nodes.name: seedConfig
nodes.summary: Seeds road_config defaults (toll, bonuses, default driver salary) and fuel config when the tables are empty.

nodes.name: generateMonthTrips
nodes.summary: Generates a month of synthetic trips with randomized routes, customers, and VND amounts for dashboard chart volume.

nodes.name: seedTrips
nodes.summary: Inserts generated trips across months with per-trip duplicate guards so re-runs stay idempotent.

nodes.name: insertLedgerEntry
nodes.summary: Inserts one ledger transaction row tied to a customer, trip, and dated entry.

nodes.name: seedReceivables
nodes.summary: Seeds PAYMENT_RECEIVED and overdue ledger entries to populate AR aging widgets.

nodes.name: seedExpenses
nodes.summary: Seeds vendor and fuel expenses with varied approval states across trips for payables and expense views.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the dashboard seed — config, reference data, trips, receivables, expenses — and reports completion.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel module re-exporting all static seed datasets — customers, drivers, fleet, reference, pricing, samples, factories, vehicles — plus the Excel-derived ports list.

nodes.name: ports-from-excel.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated static dataset of Vietnamese port/yard entries (name, address, operation URL, lifting fee) extracted from the customer's DATA PM Excel workbook; regenerable via tools/generate-seed-data.mjs.

nodes.name: seed-customers.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds customers, partner records, and linked suppliers from the customer Excel THÔNG TIN NCC data, plus Silver Sea company-identity app settings and the 21-column Long Minh debit-note template.

nodes.name: seedCustomers
nodes.summary: Upserts customers, partners, and linked suppliers keyed by normalized tax code, returning an internal-code-to-customerId map for downstream seeders.

nodes.name: seedCompanySettings
nodes.summary: Writes the Silver Sea company identity into app_settings so exports carry the real issuer.

nodes.name: seedLongMinhDebitTemplate
nodes.summary: Seeds the Long Minh debit-note template with grouped service-fee and recoverable-expense columns matching the customer's real export layout.

nodes.name: seed-factories.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds Excel-derived factories and warehouses as operational sites referenced by shipment intake's pickup-point dropdowns; idempotent via normalized-name matching.

nodes.name: seedFactories
nodes.summary: Upserts Excel-derived factories/warehouses as operational sites with address and contact details, skipping rows that already match by normalized name.

nodes.name: seed-fleet.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds the fleet from the customer Excel roster — trucks by plate (BKS), trailers, and drivers — matching trucks to their named drivers via accent-insensitive name normalization.

nodes.name: normName
nodes.summary: Normalizes Vietnamese names by stripping diacritics and lowercasing for fuzzy driver-name matching.

nodes.name: seedFleet
nodes.summary: Upserts trucks by plate and drivers from the roster, matching trucks to named drivers and returning plate/name-to-id maps.

nodes.name: seed-forwarder-money.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds forwarder (OPS) money flows through the advance domain services: advance requests in all decision states with OPS_ADVANCE ledger entries, plus one settlement linking approved advances to their expenses.

nodes.name: seedForwarderMoney
nodes.summary: Coordinates forwarder money seeding: pending/approved/rejected advance requests plus one linked advance settlement.

nodes.name: seedAdvances
nodes.summary: Creates advance requests in PENDING, APPROVED (with OPS_ADVANCE ledger effect), and REJECTED states through the advance service.

nodes.name: seedSettlement
nodes.summary: Creates an advance settlement linking approved advances and their expenses through the domain service.

nodes.name: seed-identity.ts
nodes.summary: Shared idempotency helpers for the seed suite: text normalization plus SQL equality expressions for matching existing rows case- and whitespace-insensitively (NULL-safe variant included).

nodes.name: normalizeSeedText
nodes.summary: Trims and lowercases seed text into its canonical matching form.

nodes.name: normalizedTextEquals
nodes.summary: SQL predicate comparing a column against normalized seed text via lower(btrim(...)).

nodes.name: normalizedNullableTextEquals
nodes.summary: NULL-safe equality treating empty strings and missing values as equal for idempotent seed lookups.

nodes.name: seed-lift-pricing.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds container lift-on/lift-off (nâng/hạ) pricing per port and container size, keyed off the reference seed results.

nodes.name: seedLiftPricing
nodes.summary: Upserts lift pricing rows for each port/container-type combination using reference-seed id maps, skipping existing rows.

nodes.name: seed-pricing-tables.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds the customer-provided freight-price matrix as explicit pricing-table classes for the Long Minh customer with a fixed effective date.

nodes.name: seedPricingTables
nodes.summary: Creates pricing-table rows linking the Long Minh customer to route/container-type prices, using reference and customer seed maps.

nodes.name: seed-sample-pricing.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds freight pricing for the demo sample customers across the three seeded routes so trip creation resolves non-zero TABLE revenue, which the debit-note/AR chain derives from.

nodes.name: seedSamplePricing
nodes.summary: Upserts (customer, route, container_type, effective_date)-keyed pricing rows for sample customers, idempotently skipping existing entries.

nodes.name: seed-trips.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds trips through the real dispatch chain — carrier assignment, handoff acceptance, dispatch-order issue, status transitions, forwarder expenses, and e-POD submissions — so dispatch and ops screens hold production-shaped data; idempotent and self-satisfying its own prerequisites.

nodes.name: resolveSeedActors
nodes.summary: Resolves demo actor user ids (CUS, dispatcher, manager, accountant) by username at runtime for dispatch-chain seeding.

nodes.name: ensureTrailers
nodes.summary: Guarantees one ACTIVE trailer per ACTIVE 60C truck — a dispatch precondition — creating placeholders idempotently.

nodes.name: ensureDriverUserLinks
nodes.summary: Links driver rows to their ACTIVE user accounts, which dispatch validation requires.

nodes.name: ensureExternalCarrier
nodes.summary: Ensures an ACTIVE carrier customer plus fleet vehicles required for EXTERNAL dispatch, creating them when missing.

nodes.name: seedTrips
nodes.summary: Drives READY_FOR_DISPATCH shipments through the real dispatch chain — carrier assignment, handoff acceptance, dispatch-order issue, IN_TRANSIT/COMPLETED transitions, forwarder expenses, and e-POD submissions — skipping shipments that already have live trips.

nodes.name: seed-vehicles-from-excel.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds truck/trailer combinations from the customer Excel vehicle-type sheet (LOẠI HÌNH XE), linking drivers where roster names resolve.

nodes.name: seedVehiclesFromExcel
nodes.summary: Upserts trucks with their trailer pairings from the Excel dataset, linking drivers by normalized name where resolvable.

nodes.name: seed-vendor-financials.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds vendor-side financials through domain services: company expenses producing VENDOR ledger payables, and approved fuel invoices with per-trip allocations for fuel reconciliation.

nodes.name: seedVendorFinancials
nodes.summary: Entry point seeding vendor-side financials: company expenses and approved fuel invoices with trip allocations.

nodes.name: seedCompanyExpenses
nodes.summary: Creates company expenses through the expense service, producing VENDOR ledger payables for the payables and expenses views.

nodes.name: seedFuelInvoices
nodes.summary: Creates fuel invoices with per-trip allocations and approves them for fuel-recon reporting.

nodes.name: wipe.ts
nodes.summary: Wipe utility that TRUNCATEs all business tables in one CASCADE statement while contractually preserving user accounts, push subscriptions, agent/FAQ/knowledge, and idempotency tables; exposes the table list, a dry-run plan, and an executor.
nodes.languageNotes: Relies on Postgres TRUNCATE ... CASCADE to resolve FK order rather than manual sequencing; the explicit table list is the source of truth kept in sync with schema.ts.

nodes.name: wipeTableList
nodes.summary: Returns the flat wipe-list table names for dry-run output and tooling.

nodes.name: planWipe
nodes.summary: Computes the wipe plan (statement plus table list) without executing anything, for dry runs.

nodes.name: executeWipe
nodes.summary: Executes the TRUNCATE ... CASCADE wipe of business tables inside a transaction while preserving auth tables.

nodes.name: application-owned-uniqueness.service.ts
nodes.summary: Provides Postgres advisory transaction locks that serialize application-owned uniqueness constraints (scope + parts) where dedicated unique indexes are not expressible.
nodes.languageNotes: Composite keys are serialized with a unit-separator delimiter and locked via pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(key, 0)) — the xact variant auto-releases at commit/rollback.

nodes.name: lockApplicationOwnedUniqueness
nodes.summary: Acquires a Postgres advisory transaction lock for one application-owned uniqueness scope.

nodes.name: lockApplicationOwnedUniquenessSet
nodes.summary: Acquires sorted, deduplicated advisory locks for a set of uniqueness scopes in deterministic order.

nodes.name: application-relationship.service.ts
nodes.summary: Central row-locking helpers for application-owned relationships: lock active customers, business units, shipments, users, drivers, fleet, and suppliers in deterministic order to serialize dependent mutations.

nodes.name: lockActiveCustomerIds
nodes.summary: Locks active customer rows for update within a transaction, rejecting missing or inactive customers.

nodes.name: lockActiveBusinessUnitIds
nodes.summary: Locks active business-unit rows for update, validating existence.

nodes.name: lockShipmentRows
nodes.summary: Locks shipment rows in id order to serialize dependent mutations.

nodes.name: lockUserRowForUpdate
nodes.summary: Locks a user row for update with a customizable not-found error.

nodes.name: lockDriverRowForUpdate
nodes.summary: Locks a driver row for update with a customizable not-found error.

nodes.name: lockTruckRow
nodes.summary: Locks a truck row in share or update mode, tolerating missing rows when allowed.

nodes.name: lockTrailerRow
nodes.summary: Locks a trailer row in share or update mode with optional missing-row tolerance.

nodes.name: lockSupplierRow
nodes.summary: Locks a supplier row in share or update mode with optional missing-row tolerance.

nodes.name: cascadeDeleteUserLinks
nodes.summary: Deletes rows linking a user across role tables when the user is removed.

nodes.name: ar-split-report.service.ts
nodes.summary: Builds the AR split report that breaks customer receivables into aging/current buckets directly from ledger and billing document tables.

nodes.name: getArSplitReport
nodes.summary: Aggregates customer receivable balances into the AR split report shape, grouping ledger rows by aging bucket and returning per-customer totals.

nodes.name: ar-status.service.ts
nodes.summary: Computes accounts-receivable status for individual trips and per-customer summaries, resolving due dates through the business calendar and customer receivable authority rules.

nodes.name: getTripArStatus
nodes.summary: Resolves the full AR status of a trip: receivable amount, due date, paid/allocated amounts, overdue days, and dispute state, reconciling billing documents with ledger postings.

nodes.name: getCustomerArSummary
nodes.summary: Rolls up AR status across all of a customer's trips into a summary with totals, overdue amounts, and worst-case aging.

nodes.name: audit-query.service.ts
nodes.summary: Queries and shapes audit-log views for different roles, building dynamic filter conditions (finance domain, accountant assignment) and redacting payloads for accountant visibility.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses raw Drizzle sql fragments as composable condition builders (eventSql, entityTypeSql, pathPrefixSql) — a pattern shared across this codebase's reporting services.

nodes.name: accountantAssignmentCondition
nodes.summary: Builds the visibility condition restricting accountants to audit entries about customers/shipments they are assigned to, joining assignment tables into an OR condition tree.

nodes.name: redactPayloadForAccountant
nodes.summary: Strips sensitive top-level payload fields before an audit entry is returned to an accountant.

nodes.name: classifyAuditCategory
nodes.summary: Maps an audit-log entity type and path to a user-facing category label.

nodes.name: queryAuditLogs
nodes.summary: Main entry point: paginates and filters audit logs per the viewer's role, applying accountant scope conditions, redaction, and category classification.

nodes.name: billing-overlap-guard.service.ts
nodes.summary: Prevents duplicate billing claims: locks the overlap authority per entity scope and checks that trips/expenses are not already claimed by another billing document.

nodes.name: lockBillingDocumentOverlapAuthority
nodes.summary: Acquires the application-owned uniqueness lock over a document's overlap scope before claim checks run.

nodes.name: checkBillingDocumentOverlap
nodes.summary: Verifies that none of the document's claimed trips/expenses are already actively claimed by a different billing document, throwing a descriptive conflict otherwise.

nodes.name: business-calendar.service.ts
nodes.summary: Business-calendar date math on top of configured calendar days: business-day detection, payment due dates for customers and suppliers, and overdue-day counting.

nodes.name: isBusinessDay
nodes.summary: Returns whether a date is a working day per the businessCalendarDays table (defaulting to Mon-Sat when unconfigured).

nodes.name: resolveBusinessDate
nodes.summary: Resolves the effective business date for a timestamp, rolling backward or forward past non-business days per direction.

nodes.name: resolvePaymentDueDate
nodes.summary: Computes a payment due date by adding N business days to an issue date.

nodes.name: resolveCustomerPaymentDueDate
nodes.summary: Resolves a customer's due date from their payment-term setting (business days vs calendar days) with fallback to the company default.

nodes.name: resolveSupplierPaymentDueDate
nodes.summary: Resolves a supplier's due date from their payment-term setting, applying the same business/calendar-day logic as the customer variant.

nodes.name: calendarDaysOverdue
nodes.summary: Counts calendar days overdue between a due date and an as-of date, floored at zero.

nodes.name: carrier-fleet-vehicle.service.ts
nodes.summary: CRUD for carrier-owned fleet vehicles linked to shipment fulfillments, with plate normalization and active-carrier validation.

nodes.name: assertActiveCarrier
nodes.summary: Validates that the acting carrier principal is active before fleet mutations are allowed.

nodes.name: listCarrierFleetVehicles
nodes.summary: Lists fleet vehicles visible to the acting carrier.

nodes.name: createCarrierFleetVehicle
nodes.summary: Creates a fleet vehicle for a carrier with normalized plate and type, rejecting duplicates.

nodes.name: updateCarrierFleetVehicle
nodes.summary: Updates a fleet vehicle after ownership validation, re-normalizing the plate and guarding against reassignment.

nodes.name: clerk-shipment-scope.service.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves the shipment visibility scope for clerk users: which customers, business units, and assigned shipments a clerk may see, and the where-clauses enforcing that scope.

nodes.name: loadClerkShipmentScope
nodes.summary: Loads a clerk's effective shipment scope from user-customer links, business-unit links, and shipment assignments.

nodes.name: buildShipmentScopeWhere
nodes.summary: Builds the Drizzle where-condition restricting shipment queries to the clerk's scope, bypassed for unscoped roles.

nodes.name: assertClerkCanAccessShipment
nodes.summary: Throws an authorization error when a shipment falls outside the clerk's scope.

nodes.name: resolveClerkResponsibleUnitId
nodes.summary: Resolves the business unit a clerk is responsible for, used as the default unit when they create shipments.

nodes.name: assertClerkCanCreateForCustomer
nodes.summary: Validates that a clerk may create shipments for a given customer per their scope.

nodes.name: company-info.service.ts
nodes.summary: Loads the company identity block (name, tax code, address, logo keys) from app settings with defaults, for use on documents and exports.

nodes.name: companyInfoFromSettings
nodes.summary: Projects raw app-settings rows into the typed company-info shape, filling defaults for missing keys.

nodes.name: getCompanyInfo
nodes.summary: Loads the company info block from app settings.

nodes.name: config.service.ts
nodes.summary: Configuration and master-data service: bootstrap payload for catalogs, pricing resolution, fuel config with history, customer/supplier uniqueness validation and link mirroring.

nodes.name: getBootstrapData
nodes.summary: Assembles the bootstrap payload of catalog data (customers, routes, trucks, drivers, cargo types) that the frontend loads at startup.

nodes.name: getPricing
nodes.summary: Resolves the effective pricing table for a route/cargo combination.

nodes.name: upsertFuelConfigInTx
nodes.summary: Upserts fuel configuration inside a transaction, validating consumption norms and recording price history.

nodes.name: validateCustomerUniqueness
nodes.summary: Validates that a new/edited customer is unique by tax code and normalized name before insert.

nodes.name: mirrorCustomerLink
nodes.summary: Mirrors customer creation into the user-customer link table so assignment-based scoping keeps working.

nodes.name: mirrorSupplierLink
nodes.summary: Mirrors supplier creation into user link tables for scope enforcement, mirroring the customer variant.

nodes.name: customer-receivable-authority.service.ts
nodes.summary: Computes authoritative customer receivable positions as of a Vietnam-time cutoff: due-date ordering, direct vs offset authority classification, and per-customer snapshot rollups.
nodes.languageNotes: The 398-line getCustomerReceivableSnapshots carries the whole module; it reconciles ledger, billing documents, and debt offsets into one authoritative balance per customer.

nodes.name: resolveVietnamAsOfCutoff
nodes.summary: Normalizes an as-of timestamp to the Vietnam-time business-day cutoff used by all receivable authority computations.

nodes.name: getCustomerReceivableSnapshot
nodes.summary: Loads the receivable snapshot for one customer as of a cutoff.

nodes.name: getCustomerReceivableSnapshots
nodes.summary: Builds authoritative per-customer receivable snapshots as of a cutoff: loads ledger and document rows, applies due-date ordering and authority classification, and reconciles payments, offsets, and adjustments.

nodes.name: dashboard-stats.service.ts
nodes.summary: Assembles the main dashboard: operational stats (dispatch stall, yard expiry, congestion alerts), decision queues for governance approvals, and fuel-warning counts, with Redis-cached aggregation.

nodes.name: getCongestionAlertCounts
nodes.summary: Counts congestion alert conditions (yard overload, dispatch queue buildup) for the dashboard alert strip.

nodes.name: getDashboardStats
nodes.summary: Main dashboard payload: revenue/expense aggregates, trip status counts, congestion alerts, and period comparisons, cached in Redis.

nodes.name: buildDecisionItems
nodes.summary: Builds the pending-decision list across governance domains (overrides, debt offsets, adjustments) with enriched display fields.

nodes.name: dashboard-widgets.service.ts
nodes.summary: Provides the lighter dashboard widget payloads (P&L summary, receivable/payable tiles) with Redis caching and period filtering.

nodes.name: getDashboardWidgets
nodes.summary: Assembles widget payloads (P&L totals, AR/AP tiles) for the requested period, caching results in Redis.

nodes.name: delete-authorization.service.ts
nodes.summary: Governs record deletion: role-based can-delete rules with idle-time windows, scope locking, and a review workflow for deletes that require approval.

nodes.name: canDelete
nodes.summary: Decides whether an actor may directly delete an entity given their role, the record's age within the idle window, and its dependency state.

nodes.name: requireCanDelete
nodes.summary: Throwing wrapper around canDelete used as a guard in delete routes.

nodes.name: lockDeleteEntityScope
nodes.summary: Acquires the uniqueness lock over the entity scope so concurrent delete requests serialize.

nodes.name: createDeleteRequest
nodes.summary: Creates a delete request for records that need review instead of direct deletion.

nodes.name: reviewDeleteRequest
nodes.summary: Approves or rejects a pending delete request, performing the deletion on approval.

nodes.name: delivery-confirm.service.ts
nodes.summary: Confirms container delivery at ports/yards: validates the delivery milestone, records confirmation, and computes demurrage/detention free time from calendar rules.

nodes.name: confirmDelivery
nodes.summary: Records delivery confirmation for a container: validates the milestone sequence, stamps the confirmation, and updates the shipment milestone.

nodes.name: calculateFreeTime
nodes.summary: Computes the free-time window (and its expiry) for a container from the site's rules and the confirmation timestamp.

nodes.name: disbursement-period.service.ts
nodes.summary: Validates disbursement allocations against period authority: checks allocation completeness and asserts allocation is allowed while the period is writable.

nodes.name: checkDisbursementAllocation
nodes.summary: Checks whether a disbursement can be allocated in its period, returning blocking reasons like closed period locks.

nodes.name: assertCanAllocateDisbursement
nodes.summary: Throwing guard that a disbursement's period is still open for allocation.

nodes.name: driver.service.ts
nodes.summary: The driver mobile-app backend (1,300 lines): trip lists and detail views, two-orders view, fulfillment progress with milestone sequence enforcement, earnings, alerts, incidental costs, and payslip periods.

nodes.name: assertDispatchableDriverPrincipal
nodes.summary: Validates that the acting user maps to an active, dispatchable driver profile before driver-app operations.

nodes.name: getDriverTrips
nodes.summary: Lists the driver's assigned trips with today grouping and status filtering for the mobile app home screen.

nodes.name: getDriverTwoOrdersView
nodes.summary: Builds the two-orders daily view pairing each truck's AM/PM orders with containers, sites, and progress state.

nodes.name: getDriverTripDetail
nodes.summary: Loads full detail for one driver trip including containers, instructions, and photo requirements.

nodes.name: getDriverFulfillmentDetail
nodes.summary: Loads a fulfillment's driver-facing detail with its milestone sequence and next required action.

nodes.name: getDriverEarnings
nodes.summary: Computes driver earnings for a period from trip salaries, incidental costs, and penalties.

nodes.name: getDriverVehicleAlerts
nodes.summary: Collects vehicle-related alerts (insurance, registration expiry) for the driver's assigned trucks.

nodes.name: recordDriverFulfillmentProgress
nodes.summary: Records a driver's progress event on a fulfillment, enforcing the milestone order and firing start side effects.

nodes.name: syncDriverFulfillmentStartSideEffects
nodes.summary: Runs side effects when a driver starts a fulfillment: attendance sync, notifications, and status propagation.

nodes.name: recordIncidentalCost
nodes.summary: Records an incidental cost (toll, fine, meal) claimed by a driver against a trip.

nodes.name: completeOwnedFulfillmentTrip
nodes.summary: Completes a driver-owned fulfillment trip after verifying completion evidence, triggering downstream completion recompute.

nodes.name: getDriverPayslipPeriods
nodes.summary: Lists the driver's payslip periods with computed totals for the mobile earnings screen.

nodes.name: NoDriverProfileError
nodes.summary: Dedicated error class thrown when a user principal has no driver profile, carrying a stable code for the client.

nodes.name: email-settings.service.ts
nodes.summary: Loads and saves SMTP/email provider settings stored in app settings, with AES encryption of the API key via the crypto helper and cache invalidation on save.

nodes.name: loadEmailSettings
nodes.summary: Loads raw email settings rows from app settings.

nodes.name: getEmailSettings
nodes.summary: Returns the decrypted, typed email settings for outbound mail.

nodes.name: saveEmailSettings
nodes.summary: Persists email settings and invalidates the cached copy.

nodes.name: saveEmailSettingsInTx
nodes.summary: Writes email settings rows inside a caller-owned transaction, encrypting the provider API key.

nodes.name: email.service.ts
nodes.summary: Outbound email delivery through the Resend provider with full audit logging: send with per-log records, timeout-guarded fetch, retry claiming, and status normalization.

nodes.name: sendEmail
nodes.summary: Sends an email through the configured provider, creating an audit log row first so failures are still recorded.

nodes.name: createEmailLog
nodes.summary: Creates the audit log row for an outbound email attempt.

nodes.name: retryEmail
nodes.summary: Retries a failed email attempt when retry budget remains, claiming the attempt to prevent double sends.

nodes.name: deliverLoggedEmail
nodes.summary: Delivers an already-logged email through the provider, marking the log sent or failed with provider diagnostics.

nodes.name: markLoggedEmailFailed
nodes.summary: Marks an email log failed with the provider error payload.

nodes.name: claimRetryEmailAttempt
nodes.summary: Atomically claims a retry attempt on a failed email so concurrent retry jobs cannot double-send.

nodes.name: fetchResendWithTimeout
nodes.summary: Calls the Resend API with an abort-controller timeout so hung provider calls cannot stall the queue.

nodes.name: field-cost.service.ts
nodes.summary: O2C field-operations cost capture: lets FORWARDER staff record paid-on-behalf trip costs with receipt photos, field-filtering every response so Ops never see margin, salary, or cost-of-goods data (PRD §B0).

nodes.name: recordFieldCost
nodes.summary: Validates and records a FORWARDER paid-on-behalf field cost with receipt photo, enforcing shipment-accounting-unlocked state and returning a margin/salary-filtered response view.

nodes.name: resolveExternalCarrier
nodes.summary: Resolves a trip's external-carrier soft pointer to a ledger entity reference, returning null for OWN-operated trips.

nodes.name: financial-posting.service.ts
nodes.summary: Creates and supersedes the immutable financial version for a trip: retry-safe completion, governed corrections superseding the current version, cancellation reversing it. Callers must already hold the trip financial-authority lock.

nodes.name: getActiveFinancialPosting
nodes.summary: Loads the currently active immutable financial version row for a trip.

nodes.name: getFinancialPostingForGovernanceAction
nodes.summary: Loads the financial-posting version a governance action targets, validating it matches the trip's current version.

nodes.name: createFinancialPosting
nodes.summary: Creates the immutable trip financial version inside the caller's transaction; retry-safe on completion, superseding on governed correction, reversing on cancellation.

nodes.name: forwarder-trip-query.service.ts
nodes.summary: Scoped read layer for FORWARDER-facing trip data: enforces per-forwarder trip/shipment visibility and mutability asserts, then serves trip lists, counts, and rich trip detail with photos and expense completion state.

nodes.name: assertForwarderTripScope
nodes.summary: Asserts a forwarder principal is allowed to see a given trip.

nodes.name: assertForwarderMutableTripScope
nodes.summary: Asserts a forwarder may mutate a trip, also checking trip status and accounting-lock state.

nodes.name: assertForwarderMutableShipmentScope
nodes.summary: Asserts a forwarder may mutate resources belonging to a shipment linked to a trip.

nodes.name: getForwarderTrips
nodes.summary: Lists trips visible to a forwarder with filters, status joins, and pagination.

nodes.name: latestTripPhotoKey
nodes.summary: Extracts the most recent photo storage key for a trip row.

nodes.name: listTripPhotoKeys
nodes.summary: Lists all photo storage keys attached to a trip.

nodes.name: getForwarderTripCounts
nodes.summary: Computes per-status trip counts for a forwarder's dashboard tiles.

nodes.name: getForwarderTripDetail
nodes.summary: Loads the full forwarder-facing trip detail: legs, containers, instructions, photos, and expense completion state.

nodes.name: fuel-ap-recon.service.ts
nodes.summary: Fuel accounts-payable reconciliation: two-pass report comparing expected fuel cost per supplier/truck (from VENDOR-locked trip fuel and approved fuel invoices) against actuals, surfacing variances per truck with status classification.

nodes.name: getFuelApReconciliation
nodes.summary: Builds the monthly fuel AP reconciliation: expected fuel cost per supplier/truck from locked trip fuel plus approved fuel invoices, diffed against actuals with per-truck variance status.

nodes.name: fuel-evidence-review.service.ts
nodes.summary: Fuel-evidence review workflow: persists pump-reading OCR evidence submitted by drivers, lists reviews for trip and office views, and records office approve/reject decisions with anomaly flags.

nodes.name: agentSocket.ts
nodes.summary: Real-time socket.io transport for the AI command-and-insight assistant: mounts the /agent namespace on the Express HTTP server, authenticates the JWT handshake, rate-limits turns, and routes each message through intent classification into FAQ/lookup/summary/financial-overview/deterministic-report lanes.
nodes.languageNotes: JWT travels in the socket.io handshake (auth.token) rather than a header; per-session memory is char-capped and in-memory only, while durable history stays on REST.

nodes.name: renderResponseText
nodes.summary: Renders a final AgentResponse as compact text for in-session replay history.

nodes.name: initAgentSocket
nodes.summary: Creates the /agent socket.io namespace on the shared HTTP server and registers its auth and message handlers.

nodes.name: registerAuth
nodes.summary: Validates the socket.io handshake JWT (signature, expiry, Redis blacklist, office role) and rejects unauthorized connections.

nodes.name: registerHandlers
nodes.summary: Main chat handler: enforces the runtime bot switch and rate limits, preserves per-session context, classifies intent, dispatches to the FAQ fast lane, lookup, summary, financial-overview, or deterministic-report lanes or the LLM orchestrator, streams AG-UI protocol events, and records turn outcomes.

nodes.name: enforcer.ts
nodes.summary: Initializes and exposes the singleton Casbin enforcer built from model.conf and policy.csv, logging the loaded policy count at boot.
nodes.languageNotes: Policy is loaded once at process boot; under tsx watch, policy.csv edits require a process restart to take effect.

nodes.name: initEnforcer
nodes.summary: Builds the Casbin enforcer from model.conf and policy.csv, caches it as the module singleton, and returns it.

nodes.name: getEnforcer
nodes.summary: Returns the initialized enforcer singleton, throwing if initEnforcer has not run yet.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Central environment configuration: loads dotenv then validates JWT secrets, database/Redis URLs, ports, VAPID push settings, trust-proxy handling, and feature flags through a Zod schema into a typed config object.
nodes.languageNotes: Process-supplied env values deliberately override the local .env file; trust proxy defaults to 1 hop in production so req.ip survives the Docker/nginx bridge.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Backend entry point: bootstraps telemetry, Express, Casbin, the database and Redis; mounts every API router behind auth/Casbin gates; initializes the agent socket, audit/notification/push services, scheduler jobs, and graceful shutdown.
nodes.languageNotes: The telemetry import must stay first — OpenTelemetry auto-instrumentation only patches modules loaded after SDK init under ESM + tsx watch.

nodes.name: shutdown
nodes.summary: Graceful-shutdown handler that stops the scheduler, disconnects Redis, closes the HTTP server, and exits on SIGTERM/SIGINT.

nodes.name: redis.ts
nodes.summary: Redis client singleton plus a request-coalescing cache layer (single-flight gets, version-tracked invalidation, pattern flush, report-cache invalidation) and JWT blacklist helpers used by auth middleware and route caching.
nodes.languageNotes: In-flight promise deduplication prevents cache stampedes; a version counter per key lets invalidation beat racing fills.

nodes.name: getRedis
nodes.summary: Lazily creates and returns the shared ioredis client singleton.

nodes.name: disconnectRedis
nodes.summary: Closes the Redis connection if open, used during graceful shutdown and tests.

nodes.name: cacheGet
nodes.summary: Read-through cache get with TTL that coalesces concurrent misses into a single fetch and re-invalidates if a version bump races the fill.

nodes.name: cacheInvalidate
nodes.summary: Invalidates a single cache key by bumping its version and deleting the entry.

nodes.name: cacheInvalidatePattern
nodes.summary: Invalidates all cache keys matching a glob pattern via SCAN.

nodes.name: invalidateReportCaches
nodes.summary: Flushes the family of report cache keys after data mutations so dashboards and exports recompute.

nodes.name: isTokenBlacklisted
nodes.summary: Checks whether a JWT id (jti) has been blacklisted by logout or revocation.

nodes.name: blacklistToken
nodes.summary: Blacklists a JWT id for a TTL matching the token's remaining lifetime.

nodes.name: scoped-by-customer.ts
nodes.summary: Pure row-scope helpers that force CUSTOMER-role queries to the user's linked customer ids, overwriting caller-supplied filters and applying a deny-all sentinel for unlinked accounts; consumed by the customer portal and customer-reachable financial endpoints.
nodes.languageNotes: DENY_ALL_CUSTOMER_ID is a negative sentinel that can never collide with real positive serial ids, so a misconfigured customer user sees zero rows instead of leaking data.

nodes.name: isCustomerScoped
nodes.summary: Returns true when the user is a CUSTOMER-role account whose queries must be row-scoped to a customer.

nodes.name: customerScopeIds
nodes.summary: Resolves the customer ids a user may see: the linked set for CUSTOMER roles, or a passthrough marker for operator roles.

nodes.name: scopedByCustomer
nodes.summary: Rewrites a Drizzle query's customer filter: forces the primary customer link for CUSTOMER users and preserves operator intent otherwise.

nodes.name: scopedByCustomerIds
nodes.summary: Scopes a query to the full linked-customer set (portal list endpoints showing all linked accounts), deny-all when unlinked.

nodes.name: canAccessCustomer
nodes.summary: Row-level access check for a single customer id: linked-set membership for CUSTOMER users, always true for operators.

nodes.name: telemetry.ts
nodes.summary: OpenTelemetry SDK bootstrap that configures OTLP or console trace exporters and a ratio-based sampler from environment variables; must be the first import in index.ts.
nodes.languageNotes: Under ESM + tsx watch, auto-instrumentation can only patch modules loaded after this file initializes, hence the first-import contract.

nodes.name: readSamplerRatio
nodes.summary: Parses the trace sampler ratio (0..1) from OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG with a safe default.

nodes.name: startSdk
nodes.summary: Assembles resource, exporter, sampler, and auto-instrumentations into a NodeSDK and starts tracing, with console diagnostics.

nodes.name: validation.ts
nodes.summary: Converts a failed Zod parse into a 400 ApiError with a 'message (field)' shape consistent with the global error handler.

nodes.name: throwValidation
nodes.summary: Throws a formatted ApiError from a ZodError, joining field paths into the message and detail string.

nodes.name: asyncHandler.ts
nodes.summary: Express wrapper that catches promise rejections from async route handlers and forwards them to the global error handler.

nodes.name: asyncHandler
nodes.summary: Wraps an async request handler so a rejected promise is routed through next(err) instead of crashing the request.

nodes.name: audit.ts
nodes.summary: Audit-logging middleware that maps mutating requests to registered audit events, sanitizes payloads, runs handlers inside an audit request context, and persists material-write audit outcomes (success, conflict, failure) transactionally.
nodes.languageNotes: Audit persistence failure fails the request with a Vietnamese user-facing message, making the audit trail a hard invariant rather than best-effort logging.

nodes.name: auditLogMiddleware
nodes.summary: Intercepts mutating responses, resolves the audit event for the method+path, records request metadata and sanitized body, and schedules durable audit persistence tied to the response outcome.

nodes.name: auth.ts
nodes.summary: JWT authentication middleware: verifies the bearer token against the Redis blacklist, loads the user with role and customer scope, detects token/customer-scope drift, and attaches req.user for downstream handlers; also provides a signed-URL asset variant and the getUser accessor.

nodes.name: loadCurrentCustomerIds
nodes.summary: Loads the user's current customer links from the database so freshly linked or unlinked accounts invalidate tokens carrying stale customer scopes.

nodes.name: sameCustomerScope
nodes.summary: Compares the token's embedded customer ids against the database's current set to reject tokens issued before a scope change.

nodes.name: authMiddleware
nodes.summary: Verifies the JWT (signature, expiry, blacklist, customer-scope freshness) and attaches the AuthUser to req.user, or responds 401.

nodes.name: assetAuthMiddleware
nodes.summary: Authenticates signed-URL asset requests (photos/downloads) with the same token checks as authMiddleware but tolerant of header-less access.

nodes.name: getUser
nodes.summary: Type-safe accessor that returns req.user or throws when a handler runs without authentication.

nodes.name: casbin.ts
nodes.summary: Authorization middleware translating HTTP methods to Casbin actions (read/write/delete) against route-scoped resources, plus requireRoles for hard role gates and tripRouteAuthz for trip-scoped checks.

nodes.name: registry.ts
nodes.summary: In-memory registry of cron scheduler jobs with kebab-case name validation, listing, and a deterministic Postgres advisory-lock key derived from the job name.

nodes.name: registerJob
nodes.summary: Registers a scheduler job after validating its kebab-case name and rejects duplicate registrations.

nodes.name: getJob
nodes.summary: Looks up a registered scheduler job definition by name.

nodes.name: listJobs
nodes.summary: Returns all registered scheduler jobs as an array for the runner and diagnostics.

nodes.name: clearRegistry
nodes.summary: Clears all registered scheduler jobs; used by tests to reset registry state between cases.

nodes.name: advisoryLockKey
nodes.summary: Derives a deterministic 32-bit Postgres advisory-lock key from a job name using an FNV-style hash so multiple app instances never double-run the same job.

nodes.name: runner.ts
nodes.summary: Cron scheduler runner that schedules registered jobs, acquires per-job Postgres advisory locks so only one instance executes each tick, retries with backoff, and persists run status and log rows.

nodes.name: startScheduler
nodes.summary: Validates cron expressions and schedules every enabled registered job with node-cron, tracking in-flight promises so shutdown can drain them.

nodes.name: stopScheduler
nodes.summary: Stops all scheduled tasks and drains in-flight job promises within a configurable window.

nodes.name: runJobTick
nodes.summary: Executes one job tick: reserves a pooled connection, takes a session-level Postgres advisory lock so only one instance runs the job, delegates to executeWithRetries, and persists status transitions.

nodes.name: executeWithRetries
nodes.summary: Runs a job handler with bounded retries and inter-attempt delay, writing run status after each attempt.

nodes.name: safeWrite
nodes.summary: Writes a scheduler run-status row while swallowing and logging write errors so status persistence never fails the job itself.

nodes.name: deterministic-report-lane.ts
nodes.summary: Deterministic (non-LLM) agent lane that renders the monthly P&L plus receivables and payables summaries straight from the reporting services as VND-formatted Vietnamese markdown.

nodes.name: runDeterministicReport
nodes.summary: Computes a period-resolved P&L report plus receivables/payables aging summaries and formats them into a Vietnamese markdown insight response without calling the LLM.

nodes.name: faq-fast-lane.ts
nodes.summary: FAQ fast path for the agent: tries exact normalized-question matches against faqEntries, then pgvector semantic search with a score floor and margin, skipping the LLM entirely on a confident hit.
nodes.languageNotes: Two-stage match: exact normalized equality first, then pgvector cosine similarity gated by SCORE_FLOOR/MARGIN acceptance thresholds; query embeddings are cached in Redis.

nodes.name: tryExactMatch
nodes.summary: Loads active FAQ entries and checks each question and its variants for an exact normalized match against the query.

nodes.name: trySemanticMatch
nodes.summary: Embeds the normalized query (Redis-cached) and runs a pgvector cosine-similarity query with an ILIKE keyword fallback to rank FAQ entries.

nodes.name: pickSemanticWinner
nodes.summary: Applies score-floor and margin rules to ranked semantic rows to decide whether one FAQ wins confidently enough to bypass the LLM.

nodes.name: isExactMatch
nodes.summary: Checks a normalized query against an FAQ question and all its stored variants for equality.

nodes.name: tryFaqFastLane
nodes.summary: Entry point for the FAQ lane: normalizes the message and tries exact then semantic matching, returning null on failure so the orchestrator falls through to the LLM.

nodes.name: financial-overview-lane.ts
nodes.summary: Deterministic financial-overview lane composing P&L, receivables, and payables summaries into Vietnamese KPI widgets with anomaly flags for the current Vietnam period.

nodes.name: buildFinancialOverviewResponse
nodes.summary: Shapes computed financial data into rounded VND strings, net-margin metrics, anomaly notes, and KPI widgets for the agent response.

nodes.name: runFinancialOverview
nodes.summary: Resolves the current Vietnam period, fetches P&L plus aging summaries in parallel, and builds the financial-overview agent response.

nodes.name: intent-router.ts
nodes.summary: Rule-based Vietnamese intent router that classifies agent messages into navigation, FAQ, summary, financial-overview, deterministic-report, lookup, or general LLM lanes using normalized keyword and page-alias matching.
nodes.languageNotes: All matching runs on diacritic-stripped Vietnamese normalization with weighted page-alias/keyword tables and regex extraction — no LLM call in the routing path.

nodes.name: wordContains
nodes.summary: Checks whole-word containment with a substring fallback for normalized multi-byte text.

nodes.name: findPageMatch
nodes.summary: Scores the cleaned query against page aliases, titles, and keywords to find the best SPA page match for navigation intents.

nodes.name: extractPageQuery
nodes.summary: Strips leading navigation verbs (mo, xem, cho toi...) from a normalized query to isolate the page-search phrase.

nodes.name: routeIntent
nodes.summary: Main router: normalizes the message and dispatches to nav, FAQ, summary, financial-overview, report, lookup, or general lanes based on keyword and page matching.

nodes.name: isSummaryIntent
nodes.summary: Detects dashboard-summary phrases (tong quan, tinh hinh...) in the normalized Vietnamese query.

nodes.name: extractSimpleReportIntent
nodes.summary: Extracts a simple financial report request (period plus receivables/payables/profit focus) from the normalized query, deliberately rejecting analytical questions.

nodes.name: extractLookupQuery
nodes.summary: Extracts an entity-lookup query from 'cho toi/xem ...' phrasing when no other lane matched.

nodes.name: knowledge-ingest.ts
nodes.summary: Knowledge-base ingestion pipeline: chunks CONTEXT.md and ADR markdown by heading, embeds chunks with the embedding service, and upserts them into the knowledgeChunks pgvector table with content-hash versioning.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown chunking is heading-driven (h1-h4) with paragraph splitting for oversized sections; MD5 content hashes make re-ingestion idempotent.

nodes.name: chunkMarkdown
nodes.summary: Splits a markdown document into chunks at heading boundaries, further dividing oversized sections by paragraph.

nodes.name: flushChunk
nodes.summary: Emits one accumulated chunk, splitting it further when it exceeds the max size and deriving a heading from the first line when absent.

nodes.name: ingestChunks
nodes.summary: Embeds chunks in one batch, deletes stale rows for the same source, and inserts fresh knowledgeChunks rows with vector literals and content hashes.

nodes.name: readContextMd
nodes.summary: Reads and chunks the repo's CONTEXT.md knowledge source when present.

nodes.name: readAdrs
nodes.summary: Reads every ADR markdown file under the docs/adr directory and chunks each for ingestion.

nodes.name: ingestAll
nodes.summary: Runs the full ingestion pass over CONTEXT.md plus ADRs and reports counts and errors.

nodes.name: knowledge-retrieval.ts
nodes.summary: Semantic knowledge retrieval over ingested chunks: Redis-cached query embedding plus pgvector cosine search returning cited snippets to ground the agent's RAG answers.

nodes.name: chunkToCitation
nodes.summary: Converts a knowledge chunk row into a citation object with title, doc id, and snippet.

nodes.name: retrieveKnowledge
nodes.summary: Embeds the query (cached), runs a pgvector top-K cosine-similarity query, and maps rows to citations for grounding agent answers.

nodes.name: lookup-lane.ts

nodes.name: runLookup
nodes.summary: Executes a semantic entity search for the query and formats the grouped results into a timed lookup response.

nodes.name: formatLookupResponse
nodes.summary: Groups search results by entity, renders Vietnamese headers with row details, and appends navigation actions.

nodes.name: formatRowDetail
nodes.summary: Renders one result row's key fields as a compact detail string for the lookup response.

nodes.name: buildLookupActions
nodes.summary: Builds deduplicated navigate-to-detail actions from lookup results so the user can jump to the found records.

nodes.name: orchestrator.ts
nodes.summary: Core agent orchestrator: runs the MiniMax tool-calling loop with role-filtered tools, streams sanitized text deltas, executes readonly tools concurrently, sanitizes structured JSON responses and directives, and persists per-lane conversation turns.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements a bounded agentic loop (selectTools → callMiniMaxStream → execute tools → produceFinalAnswer) with Vietnamese-language system prompts, a readonly-tool concurrency cache, and multi-layer output sanitizers that strip internal contract leaks before SSE emission.

nodes.name: toolsToMiniMax
nodes.summary: Converts internal AgentToolDef definitions into MiniMax function-tool descriptors with zod-derived JSON schemas.

nodes.name: directiveAckText
nodes.summary: Builds the Vietnamese acknowledgement text shown when the UI confirms an agent directive.

nodes.name: synthesizeNavigateFromProse
nodes.summary: Extracts an SPA route reference from free-text model output and synthesizes a navigate directive with numeric-only params.

nodes.name: synthesizeTextActionsFromProse
nodes.summary: Wraps prose navigation extraction to produce UI action directives from plain-text answers.

nodes.name: runAgent
nodes.summary: Main agent loop: selects role-appropriate tools, streams MiniMax responses through a safe-text delta filter, executes tool calls (readonly ones concurrently with caching), handles directives with UI acks, and produces the final sanitized answer with token attribution.

nodes.name: produceFinalAnswer
nodes.summary: Forces a final natural-language answer from the model when the tool loop ends without one, streaming it through the sanitizer and salvaging text from malformed JSON when needed.

nodes.name: parseLatestAssistantResponse
nodes.summary: Finds and returns the most recent assistant message content from the conversation stack.

nodes.name: parseAgentResponseContent
nodes.summary: Parses raw model content into structured agent response objects, tolerating surrounding prose and fenced JSON.

nodes.name: tryParseJson
nodes.summary: Attempts JSON.parse on trimmed text, returning null on failure instead of throwing.

nodes.name: preserveDetailedTerminalText
nodes.summary: Keeps a richer terminal text answer over a thinner summary when the candidate is substantially more detailed.

nodes.name: salvageText
nodes.summary: Recovers human-readable text from malformed model JSON by stripping markup and internal contract fragments.

nodes.name: isInternalContractLeak
nodes.summary: Detects internal schema/tool/directive vocabulary leaking into user-facing text so it can be filtered.

nodes.name: collectKnowledgeCitations
nodes.summary: Walks tool-result data structures to gather knowledge-base citations for grounding the answer.

nodes.name: sanitizeAgentJson
nodes.summary: Normalizes and validates raw model JSON into the agent's structured response contract — cards, widgets, directives, and tables — repairing common malformations before emission.

nodes.name: sanitizeDirective
nodes.summary: Validates and coerces a raw directive object into the known directive schema.

nodes.name: coerceNumeric
nodes.summary: Coerces model-provided values that should be numeric into finite numbers, defaulting on failure.

nodes.name: normalizeTableWidget
nodes.summary: Normalizes a model-emitted table widget into well-formed columns and rows for rendering.

nodes.name: extractFirstJsonObjectWithRemainder
nodes.summary: Extracts the first balanced JSON object from mixed prose-plus-JSON text along with the remainder string.

nodes.name: trimToolHistory
nodes.summary: Trims old tool-call/result message pairs from the conversation to keep the MiniMax context within budget while preserving recent turns.

nodes.name: persistTurn
nodes.summary: Persists one agent turn (user message, assistant response, tool trace, token usage) into the agentConversations/agentMessages tables.

nodes.name: recordFaqTurn
nodes.summary: Persists an FAQ-lane turn with its matched entry and latency for analytics.

nodes.name: recordNavTurn
nodes.summary: Persists a navigation-lane turn recording the matched route and query.

nodes.name: recordSummaryTurn
nodes.summary: Persists a summary-lane turn for the dashboard overview response.

nodes.name: recordLookupTurn
nodes.summary: Persists a lookup-lane turn with the query and returned entity results.

nodes.name: recordAbortedTurn
nodes.summary: Persists an aborted agent turn so cancelled conversations remain auditable.

nodes.name: routeMatcher.ts
nodes.summary: SPA route matching utilities: converts frontend path patterns into regexes, matches route keys from paths, and compares routes with numeric-only params for the agent's navigation directives.

nodes.name: matchRoute
nodes.summary: Matches a concrete SPA path against the registered route patterns and returns the route key with parsed params.

nodes.name: sameRoute
nodes.summary: Checks whether two route matches refer to the same route key and params, treating numeric params loosely.

nodes.name: hasOnlyNumericParams

nodes.name: semantic-data.service.ts

nodes.languageNotes: Uses a declarative SEMANTIC_ENTITIES registry (fields, aliases, searchable columns) compiled into parameterized Drizzle SQL — the LLM's data.* tools map onto these generic query primitives instead of hand-written endpoints.

nodes.name: listSemanticEntities
nodes.summary: Returns the keys of all registered semantic entities.

nodes.name: getSemanticEntityMeta
nodes.summary: Looks up the metadata definition for one semantic entity.

nodes.name: entityFieldNames
nodes.summary: Returns the selectable field names exposed for an entity.

nodes.name: semanticSearch
nodes.summary: Runs a cross-entity ILIKE keyword search over searchable fields and returns grouped matches for the lookup lane.

nodes.name: semanticList
nodes.summary: Lists rows of one entity filtered by the structured query with clamped pagination.

nodes.name: semanticDetail
nodes.summary: Fetches a single entity row by id.

nodes.name: semanticAggregate
nodes.summary: Computes grouped aggregates (count/sum/avg) over an entity according to the query's group-by and metric fields.

nodes.name: semanticTimeline
nodes.summary: Buckets entity rows by a date field into a timeline series for trend questions.

nodes.name: buildSelect
nodes.summary: Builds a Drizzle select projection from an entity definition and requested field list.

nodes.name: buildWhere
nodes.summary: Compiles the structured query filters into a Drizzle where clause with typed per-field comparators.

nodes.name: normalizeRow
nodes.summary: Serializes one database row into JSON-safe values (dates to ISO strings) for LLM consumption.

nodes.name: stream-sanitizer.ts
nodes.summary: Streaming text sanitizer that buffers LLM deltas until it can prove the emission is safe prose — suppressing JSON, internal contract leaks, and reasoning artifacts before they reach the SSE stream.

nodes.name: createSafeTextDeltaFilter
nodes.summary: Wraps an emit callback with a stateful filter that probes buffered text before releasing deltas, blocking structured/internal output from leaking to the user.

nodes.name: buildKpiWidget
